debug.description: Enable debug mode to output logs to _s-tui.log or custom debug file.

debug_file.description: Path to the custom debug log file.

csv_enabled.description: Enable saving statistics to a CSV file.

csv_file.description: Path to the custom CSV log file.

no_mouse.description: Disable mouse support for TTY systems.

cores.description: List of CPU core indices to monitor. Empty list means all cores.

custom_temperatures.description: List of custom temperature sensor strings in format '<sensor_bus>,<index>'. Example: 'it8792,0'. See s-tui man page for details.

custom_fans.description: List of custom fan sensor strings in format '<sensor_bus>,<index>'. Example: 'thinkpad,0'. See s-tui man page for details.
